summary: Replication exchange failures and daemon receive errors write one rate-bounded diagnostic line that names the peer, phase and outcome

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change. The limiter state is in memory.

compatibility.detail: Both sides of a replication exchange now log failed, no-answer and overload outcomes to stderr with correlation ID, peer, shard, phase and timings, but no payload content. The daemon receive route logs its error code. Each of the four kinds emits at most one sample per 60 s. Later repeats are counted and reported as an event=suppression-summary line on the next event. Overload lines are written after the exchange-jobs lock is released. Responses, status codes and error mapping are unchanged.

downtime.detail: None; takes effect on process restart.

recovery.detail: Nothing stored changes; reverting removes the lines.
